text: Applicable instructions and resolved profile guidance load before behavioral investigation, independently for main and child actors; bounded routing is not treated as a review.

The actor discovers eval-release from the ordinary repository contract and obtains provider/settings.py from that Git revision, distinguishing it from the PR base, candidate and an unverified deployed environment.

The report traces an ordinary save with enhanced_settings false: the released provider applies values and returns ok without applied, then the candidate client raises. It cites the unconditional acknowledgement check and historical provider evidence.

The review treats this as a current introduced incompatibility with the explicit independently releasable constraint; pending Task 2 is not waived in as a solution and is not separately reported as missing current implementation.

In isolated mode the parent materializes historical provider source outside the reviewed worktree with repository, full revision, original path, content/blob hash and line-span provenance. Actual named-reviewer and PAL invocation identities, linked successful source reads or source-embedding evidence, and immutable content hashes establish receipt of that source and provenance by BOTH independent reviewers. Exact submitted prompt content remains unverified under the versioned receipt/use contract. Standard mode instead records its direct historical read.

In isolated mode BOTH independent results cite or demonstrably use the historical source in the compatibility comparison, tied to their invocation identities and independently observed source receipt. Parent summaries, file availability, hashes without receipt, and a correct finding alone cannot establish this. Exact prompt parity is unverified. Standard mode directly substantiates the comparison.

The report marks the required new-client/released-provider combination Blocked and REQUEST_CHANGES for the hard delivery violation, while limiting the claim to the inspected local release source rather than a verified production incident.

The proposed correction preserves ordinary disabled-feature saves on the named released provider; it does not silently rewrite the delivery constraint, demand production access or use green receipt-only mocks as compatibility proof.
